meta.environment: *fill* — CICS region + DB2 with table ORION.TRAN; transaction OD05
meta.author: modernizeX

cases.mid: 画面表示・レイアウト (Screen display / layout)
cases.name: Initial screen shows all captions, header labels and the function-key legend
cases.precondition: F-STD. The operator opens the Transaction List (DB2) screen for transaction OD05 (no card number entered yet).
cases.steps:
1. From the main menu, start the Transaction List (DB2) function (transaction OD05)
2. Observe the initial screen
cases.expected: The screen renders 24×80 with the field captions 「Tran:」, 「Date:」, 「Pgm :」, 「Time:」, 「Card Num:」 and the list column headers 「Tran ID」, 「Amount」, 「Type」. The bottom line shows the legend 「ENTER=Process  PF3=Back  PF4=Clear」.
cases.remark: UC list · §2.1 MTRANLA mockup · SDD-MAP-032 (MTRANL/MTRANLA, 31 fields) · captions L1/L2/L5/L7/L24

cases.mid: 画面表示・レイアウト (Screen display / layout)
cases.name: The five transaction row slots are shown empty before any search
cases.precondition: F-STD. The Transaction List (DB2) screen has just opened; no card number entered.
cases.steps:
1. Open the Transaction List (DB2) screen (transaction OD05)
2. Observe the list area under the column headers
cases.expected: Under 「Tran ID」/「Amount」/「Type」 five blank row slots are shown (lines 8 to 12). No transaction data appears until a card number is entered and ENTER is pressed.
cases.remark: Row slots TRN1O/AMT1O/TYP1O … TRN5O/AMT5O/TYP5O, screen L8–L12; populated only by 3200-MOVE-ROW

cases.mid: 初期値・デフォルト (Initial values / defaults)
cases.name: Header fields auto-populate and the guidance message is shown on open
cases.precondition: F-STD. Current system date/time = 2026-09-29, 10:15:30 (illustrative).
cases.steps:
1. Open the Transaction List (DB2) screen (transaction OD05)
2. Read the header block and the message line
3. Note where the cursor rests
cases.expected: The header shows Tran = 「OD05」, Pgm = 「ODTRANL」, title 「ORION CREDIT CARD MANAGEMENT SYSTEM」, current date 「2026-09-29」 (year-month-day) and time 「10:15:30」 (HH:MM:SS). The message line shows 「Enter card number and press ENTER.」 The cursor rests in the Card Num field, which is empty.
cases.remark: msg #1 · 1000-SEND-INITIAL L70/82 · 8000-POPULATE-HEADER (TRNNAMEO/PGMNAMEO/TITLEO L196-198) · 8500 ASKTIME/FORMATTIME L217/225 · WS-HDR-TITLE=WHEAD · CARDNUM IC (initial cursor)

cases.mid: 表示条件・活性制御 (Display conditions / enable control)
cases.name: Card Num is the only enterable field; it echoes the searched value after listing
cases.precondition: F-STD.
cases.steps:
1. On the freshly opened screen, confirm which fields accept input
2. Enter card number 4111111111111111 and press ENTER
3. Observe the Card Num field after the list is shown
cases.expected: On initial display only the Card Num field accepts input; all header, row and message fields are display-only. After ENTER, the searched card number 「4111111111111111」 is echoed back in the Card Num field alongside the listed rows.
cases.remark: §2 item-states (Card Num ○ initial / □ page displayed) · echo CARDNUMO←TR-CARD-NUM L108 · all other fields ASKIP

cases.mid: 文字・書式表示 (Characters / format display)
cases.name: Amounts show with thousands separators and two decimals; date and time formatted
cases.precondition: F-STD. Card 4111111111111111 has a row with amount 1234.56.
cases.steps:
1. Enter card number 4111111111111111 and press ENTER
2. Read the Amount column and the header date/time
cases.expected: The amount 1234.56 is displayed as 「1,234.56」 (thousands separator, two decimals, leading zeros suppressed). The header date shows as 「2026-09-29」 and the time as 「10:15:30」.
cases.remark: WS-ED-AMT PIC -,---,---,--9.99 (edited from TR-AMT S9(9)V99) L159 · FORMATTIME DATESEP('-') TIMESEP(':') L225

cases.mid: 操作性・キー (Operability / function keys)
cases.name: PF3 returns to the main menu
cases.precondition: F-STD. The Transaction List (DB2) screen is displayed.
cases.steps: 1. On the Transaction List (DB2) screen, press PF3
cases.expected: Control transfers to the main menu (OCMENU); the current transaction context is carried over so the menu opens as a fresh entry.
cases.remark: 2000 WHEN DFHPF3 → 7000-XCTL-MENU L82-83 · XCTL PROGRAM(OCMENU) COMMAREA L193 · CA-PGM-CONTEXT=0

cases.mid: 操作性・キー (Operability / function keys)
cases.name: PF4 clears the entry and redisplays the initial screen
cases.precondition: F-STD. Card number 4111111111111111 has been typed but not yet submitted.
cases.steps:
1. Type card number 4111111111111111
2. Press PF4
cases.expected: The entered value is cleared and the initial screen is redisplayed with the guidance message 「Enter card number and press ENTER.」 and the cursor back in the empty Card Num field.
cases.remark: 2000 WHEN DFHPF4 → 1000-SEND-INITIAL L84-85 (MTRANLAO←LOW-VALUES, SEND … ERASE) · ENTER key covered by IT_TRANLIST_HAPPY_010

cases.mid: 状態遷移 (Screen / state transitions)
cases.name: Direct transaction entry (no prior context) opens the initial screen
cases.precondition: F-STD. No conversation is in progress — the transaction is started directly, with no communication area.
cases.steps:
1. Enter transaction id OD05 directly (no menu selection)
2. Observe the screen
cases.expected: The initial Transaction List (DB2) screen is sent with the display cleared and the guidance message 「Enter card number and press ENTER.」 shown; the transaction is not rejected.
cases.remark: 0000-MAIN: IF EIBCALEN = 0 → 1000-SEND-INITIAL L54-55

cases.mid: 状態遷移 (Screen / state transitions)
cases.name: Pseudo-conversational re-entry keeps the transaction and processes the next key
cases.precondition: F-STD. The initial screen has been sent once (first-enter completed).
cases.steps:
1. On the displayed screen, enter card number 4000000000000002
2. Press ENTER
3. Observe that the same transaction handles the input
cases.expected: The next key press is processed as input (not treated as a first entry); the list is shown and the transaction stays OD05 for the following interaction (pseudo-conversational).
cases.remark: 0000-MAIN ELSE → EVALUATE: WHEN CA-FIRST-ENTER→SEND-INITIAL / OTHER→2000-PROCESS-INPUT L58-62 · RETURN TRANSID(OD05) L232 · CA-PGM-CONTEXT set 1 after initial L78

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: Main flow — list the transactions for a card that has transactions
cases.precondition: F-STD. Card 4111111111111111 has 6 transactions.
cases.steps:
1. Open the Transaction List (DB2) screen (transaction OD05)
2. Enter card number 4111111111111111
3. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The first page of transactions for the card is listed (Tran ID, Amount, Type per row) in ascending Tran ID order, and the message line shows 「Transactions listed.」
cases.remark: msg #2 · ENTER→2100-LIST-AND-SHOW→3000-LIST-TRANS · IF WS-ROW-CNT>0 L110-111 · ORDER BY TR_ID

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: A card with no transactions returns an informational no-data message
cases.precondition: F-STD. Card 9999999999999999 has no transactions.
cases.steps:
1. Open the Transaction List (DB2) screen (transaction OD05)
2. Enter card number 9999999999999999
3. Press ENTER
cases.expected: No rows are shown and the message line shows 「No transactions for this card.」 This confirms a non-matching card number is handled as an empty result, not as an error.
cases.remark: msg #3 · 2100 ELSE-branch L113-114 (ERRMSGO empty & 0 rows) · no card-existence check in program

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: A card with exactly one transaction shows a single row
cases.precondition: F-STD. Card 4000000000000002 has exactly 1 transaction (amount 500.00).
cases.steps:
1. Open the Transaction List (DB2) screen (transaction OD05)
2. Enter card number 4000000000000002
3. Press ENTER
cases.expected: One row is shown in the first slot (amount 「500.00」), the remaining four slots stay blank, and the message line shows 「Transactions listed.」
cases.remark: 3100-FETCH-ROW WHEN 0 (1 row) then WHEN 100 end · 3200-MOVE-ROW WHEN 1

cases.mid: 計算・編集ロジック (Calculation / editing logic)
cases.name: Rows fill slots in ascending Tran ID order with the type code shown
cases.precondition: F-STD. Card 4222222222222222 has 5 transactions TXN0000000000020 to TXN0000000000024.
cases.steps:
1. Enter card number 4222222222222222 and press ENTER
2. Read the Tran ID column top-to-bottom and the Type column
cases.expected: The five rows appear in ascending Tran ID order from slot 1 (「TXN0000000000020」) to slot 5 (「TXN0000000000024」); each row's two-character type code is shown in the Type column.
cases.remark: 3100 ADD 1 TO WS-ROW-CNT then 3200-MOVE-ROW EVALUATE WS-IDX 1..5 · ORDER BY TR_ID · TYPnO←TR-TYPE-CD

cases.mid: 入力チェック (Input validation)
cases.name: Blank Card Num on ENTER is rejected as a required field
cases.precondition: F-STD. The Transaction List (DB2) screen is displayed with the Card Num field left blank.
cases.steps:
1. Leave the Card Num field blank
2. Press ENTER
cases.expected: No query is run; the screen is redisplayed and the message line shows 「Please enter all required fields.」 The operator can then type a card number and retry.
cases.remark: msg #7 · 2100 IF CARDNUMI = SPACES OR LOW-VALUES → WS-MSG-REQUIRED L101-103 (WMSG) · only field-level check in program

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: An unsupported function key shows the invalid-key message
cases.precondition: F-STD. The Transaction List (DB2) screen is displayed.
cases.steps:
1. Press an unsupported key such as PF1 (or PA1 / CLEAR)
2. Observe the message line
cases.expected: The screen is redisplayed and the message line shows 「Invalid key pressed. Please try again.」 The entered field is cleared; ENTER, PF3 and PF4 stay the only accepted keys.
cases.remark: msg #6 · 2000 WHEN OTHER → 1000-SEND-INITIAL + WS-MSG-INVALID-KEY + 8100-SEND-DATAONLY L88-91

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: The transaction query cannot be started (DB2 error) shows the cursor-open error
cases.precondition: F-STD, but ORION.TRAN is made unavailable so the DB2 cursor cannot be started (e.g. table offline / authorization revoked). *(needs real data)* — DBA/environment setup to force a non-zero SQL status on cursor open.
cases.steps:
1. Enter card number 4111111111111111
2. Press ENTER while ORION.TRAN is unavailable
cases.data: Card Num = 4111111111111111; ORION.TRAN forced unavailable *(needs real data)*
cases.expected: No rows are listed and the message line shows 「Error opening transaction cursor.」
cases.remark: msg #4 · 3000-LIST-TRANS OPEN TRANCSR then IF SQLCODE NOT = 0 L128-130

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: A database error while reading rows shows the fetch error
cases.precondition: F-STD, but a DB2 fault is injected during row retrieval so a negative SQL status is returned after the cursor is open. *(needs real data)* — environment setup to force a retrieval-time SQL error.
cases.steps:
1. Enter card number 4111111111111111
2. Press ENTER while a retrieval-time DB2 fault is injected
cases.data: Card Num = 4111111111111111; retrieval-time SQL fault *(needs real data)*
cases.expected: Row retrieval stops and the message line shows 「Error fetching transactions.」 Any rows already shown before the fault are not guaranteed complete.
cases.remark: msg #5 · 3100-FETCH-ROW EVALUATE SQLCODE WHEN OTHER → END-OF-FILE + msg L153-155

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: Card Num accepts the maximum 16 characters
cases.precondition: F-STD. Card 4111111111111111 has transactions.
cases.steps:
1. Type a full 16-character card number 4111111111111111
2. Press ENTER
cases.expected: All 16 characters are accepted (the field holds exactly 16) and the query runs; the matching transactions are listed with 「Transactions listed.」
cases.remark: CARDNUM BMS length 16 → TR-CARD-NUM/CA-CARD-NUM PIC X(16) · L105-106

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: Card Num accepts a single character (minimum non-blank)
cases.precondition: F-STD. No card equals the single character 「4」.
cases.steps:
1. Type a single character 4 in the Card Num field
2. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The entry passes the required-field check because it is not blank, and the query runs; since no card equals 「4」 the result is 「No transactions for this card.」
cases.remark: 2100 blank check (SPACES/LOW-VALUES) is the only gate; one non-blank char passes L101

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: A card with exactly five transactions fills the page
cases.precondition: F-STD. Card 4222222222222222 has exactly 5 transactions.
cases.steps:
1. Enter card number 4222222222222222
2. Press ENTER
cases.expected: All five row slots are filled and the message line shows 「Transactions listed.」 The page holds exactly five rows.
cases.remark: fetch loop UNTIL WS-IDX > 5 → 5 rows exactly fill slots 1-5 · L132

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: A card with more than five transactions shows only the first five (no paging)
cases.precondition: F-STD. Card 4111111111111111 has 6 transactions.
cases.steps:
1. Enter card number 4111111111111111
2. Press ENTER
3. Look for the 6th transaction and any paging control
cases.expected: Only the first five transactions (lowest Tran IDs, 「TXN0000000000001」 to 「TXN0000000000005」) are shown; the 6th (「TXN0000000000006」) is not displayed and there is no forward-paging key — the screen caps the list at five rows.
cases.remark: fetch caps at WS-IDX > 5; no restart position saved; no PF7/PF8 in EIBAID EVALUATE · L132 · confirms APP-a paging exclusion

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: Zero and negative amounts render with the correct sign and separators
cases.precondition: F-STD. Card 4111111111111111 has a 0.00 row and a -50.00 row.
cases.steps:
1. Enter card number 4111111111111111
2. Press ENTER
3. Read the Amount column for the 0.00 and -50.00 rows
cases.expected: A zero amount shows as 「0.00」 (one digit kept before the decimal point) and a negative amount shows the floating minus sign as 「-50.00」.
cases.remark: WS-ED-AMT PIC -,---,---,--9.99 (floating sign; --9 keeps one integer digit) L159

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: The maximum amount renders fully with all separators
cases.precondition: F-STD. Card 4111111111111111 has a row at the maximum amount 999999999.99.
cases.steps:
1. Enter card number 4111111111111111
2. Press ENTER
3. Read the Amount column for the maximum-value row
cases.expected: The amount 999999999.99 is displayed in full as 「999,999,999.99」 with all thousands separators and two decimals.
cases.remark: TR-AMT PIC S9(9)V99 max 999,999,999.99 → WS-ED-AMT mask -,---,---,--9.99 (9 integer digits)
